<img src="https://thirteenag.github.io/screens/rerev2/main2.jpg" width="760" alt="Resident Evil Revelations 2 Fusion Fix">

**Resident Evil Revelations 2 Fusion Fix** adds ultrawide and fullscreen split-screen support, lists every display resolution, and fixes stuck controls before the episode 4 final boss.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#rerev2) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/ResidentEvilRevelations2.FusionFix/)

</div>

---

## Fixes

- **Resolution list** — Every display mode of the monitor; screens narrower than 16:9 get a 16:9 picture.
- **Ultrawide** — The HUD and menus keep their 16:9 shape, fades and damage overlays cover the whole screen, movies keep their aspect, inventory items stay in place.
- **Local co-op** — Each player gets half of the screen.
- **Film grain** — Keeps its size at high resolutions.
- **Camera** — No clipping into walls next to the camera at wide aspects.
- **Frame rate** — The **VARIABLE** frame rate option is capped at the chosen limit instead of 120.
- **Episode 4** — Fix controls getting stuck before the final boss battle in episode 4.

## Options

- **Skip intro** — Skip the startup logos.
- **Field of view** — Multiplier for the ordinary third-person player camera, including local co-op. Aiming, zoom, scripted views and camera transitions retain their original field of view.
- **Video mode** — Original aspect, fill or stretch.
- **Frame rate limit** — Unlimited, refresh rate or a number.
- **Window mode** — Windowed or borderless when the game's full screen option is off.
- **Split screen** — Vertical (left/right) layout and swapped views.
- **Damage overlay, film grain** — Can be hidden.
- **Title logo** — Choose the title screen's logo.
- **RGB lighting** — Support [Logitech G LIGHTSYNC RGB Lighting](https://www.logitechg.com/innovation/lightsync-rgb.html).

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the game folder, beside the game executable, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Launch the game once to create `scripts/ResidentEvilRevelations2.FusionFix.cfg`.
4. Configure the fix on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub. Restart the game when an option requires it.




![](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/assets/4904157/9b21870b-06f2-4deb-bf41-53b38a87c336)

![](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/assets/4904157/8b852cab-627e-4712-88fd-a112132555d7)

## Settings

An old `scripts/ResidentEvilRevelations2.FusionFix.ini` isn't used anymore and can be deleted. There is no HUD aspect ratio setting, no cutscene borders and no in-game settings menu.

## Known limits

- Raw mouse input and controller-icon family selection are not supported.
